protocol.description:
This protocol allows clients to capture frames of a whole Hyprland workspaces, as opposed to individual toplevels.
Primary use case is screensharing an entire workspace via xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland.
WARNING: (I asked claude to generate this file based on hyprland-toplevel-export-v1.xml, please tell me if you see any errors in this file"

interface.name: hyprland_workspace_export_manager_v1
interface.description: An object for capturing workspace frames. The client binds to this global and uses it to create frame objects per workspace.

request.name: capture_workspace
request.description:
Create a frame object for the given workspace. The workspace is identified by its name (e.g. "1", "2", "special:magic").
The compositor will begin preparing the frame and send buffer events on the returned frame object.

arg.name: workspace_name
arg.summary: the name of the workspace to capture

arg.name: overlay_cursor
arg.summary: whether to include the cursor in the frame

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. In-flight frame objects are unaffected.

interface.name: hyprland_workspace_export_frame_v1

description.summary: a frame of a workspace ready for copy

interface.description:
Represents a single captured frame of a workspace.
The lifecycle mirrors hyprland_toplevel_export_frame_v1: 1. compositor sends buffer / linux_dmabuf events 2. compositor sends buffer_done 3. client creates a wl_buffer and sends copy request 4. compositor sends damage + flags + ready (success) OR failed (failure) 5. client destroys the frame

event.name: buffer_done
event.description: Sent once all buffer events have been sent. The client should now create a buffer and send the copy request.

request.name: copy
request.description:
Copy the workspace frame into the supplied buffer. The buffer must match the dimensions and format from the buffer events.
On success: compositor sends damage (if applicable), flags, ready. On failure: compositor sends failed.

arg.name: ignore_damage
arg.summary: if non-zero, copy even if nothing changed

event.name: flags
event.description: Sent once before the ready event.

event.name: ready
event.description: The frame has been copied successfully. Timestamp follows the same tv_sec_hi/tv_sec_lo/tv_nsec convention as toplevel export.

event.name: failed
event.description: The capture failed. The client should destroy this object.

entry.name: already_used
entry.summary: copy was already called on this frame

entry.name: invalid_buffer
entry.summary: buffer dimensions or format do not match

request.name: destroy
request.description: Can be sent at any time, including before ready or failed.
